messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — hitting a routing config typo that's spiking retries. Small hotfix only (no model or weights changes). Requesting micro-exemption to quiet window to push a canary -> full rollout. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-4321
Samir: What's the blast radius? can we limit to routers in eu-west-1 first?
Anya: Yes, plan: canary 5% eu-west, 10m observation, then 100% if green. No schema or model change. Just ENV var fix in router service. Command we’ll use for rollback if needed:
```
# rollback (manual):
deploy-bot rollback service=router env=prod region=eu-west-1 id=dpl-20250601-9
```
Lee: @Anya fine with exemption if canary stays at 5% for 10m and error budget stays <1%. Who owns monitoring during the window?
Anya: @Ops-Oncall will watch alerts and prometheus dashboards. I'll be on standby.
Deploy Bot: Deployment requested by @Anya — dpl-20250601-9. Strategy: rolling canary 5% -> 100%. Regions: eu-west-1 then global. ETA ~6m.
Ops-Oncall: Kicked off smoke tests on staging now, smoke logs look clean so far. Will post results from SLO dashboard in 5m.
Samir: infra +1 given no model changes, provided canary gating is enforced.
Lee: +1 conditional on rollback threshold (error rate > 1% OR tail latency +20%). If threshold tripped, Ops-Oncall triggers rollback and tags @oncall-lead.
Deploy Bot: Canary reached 5% in eu-west-1 (automated), monitoring window started. dpl-20250601-9
Ops-Oncall: Staging smoke green, prod pre-canary probes passed. No anomalous errors in the last 3m.
Deploy Bot: Canary advanced to 100% for router service. Status: SUCCESS. dpl-20250601-9
Anya: Thanks everyone — marking this as an allowed quiet-window exception. I'll update release notes and close the jira. Release notes snippet: 'router: fix env typo -> reduces retry storms; rolled out 2025-06-01 (canary then global)'.
Jira Bot: ABC-4321 -> Done (linked commits: git.io/rtr-fix).
Maria: Leaving a follow-up: schedule regression eval tomorrow morning and add a short check to the runbook for config-only fixes during quiet windows. :memo:
Anya: Noted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
